bundle.policy: Source APKS is binary and must be provided locally; see docs/reverse-engineering/source-artifact.md.

xxhdpiSplit.purpose: density-specific raster assets used for pixel measurements on xxhdpi Android devices

binaryPolicy.reason: The code review environment marks binary diffs as unsupported, so extracted .png/.webp files are listed in docs/reverse-engineering/asset-manifest.md instead of being committed.
binaryPolicy.textOnlyReplacement: apps/blinkit-react rebuilds the reviewed home shell using CSS, text, emoji placeholders, and tokenized measurements.

reverseEngineeringLimits: The APK contains compiled binary Android XML and obfuscated bytecode; this extraction focuses on resources, assets, UI tokens, and reconstructable product surfaces.
Live remote catalog images, prices, offers, and A/B layout payloads are API-driven and are not embedded in the APK, so mock content is labeled as replaceable data.
